subject: Proposal: Usage-tethered Net45 with Quarterly True-Up & EU VAT Evidence
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@lumetek.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: carlos.mejia@lumetek.com
Date: Sat, 21 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Net terms & VAT evidence request for pilot expansion

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Lumetek is keen to expand the pilot to a broader set of projects. A quick ask from our finance team before we redline anything: would Redwood consider Net45 terms tied to committed usage, with a quarterly true-up? Our procurement team prefers longer remit windows for consumption agreements, but we can agree an up-front committed minimum to limit exposure.

Separately, our EU entity needs to keep VAT records clean for cross-border services — can you confirm what VAT evidence/support Redwood can provide? Attached is our PO for the expanded pilot (Lumetek_PO_12345.pdf).

Main asks:
- Net45 on invoices for usage above committed minimum, with quarterly reconciliation/true-up and payment of overage within 30 days of the quarter close
- Temporary credit limit while we complete vendor checks (we have a corporate card and can do partial prepay if needed)
- VAT certificate or instruction for EU tax treatment so we can route invoices correctly

Could we aim to get a short mutual action plan this week so procurement can start paperwork?

Thanks,
Olivia Barnes
Head of Procurement | Lumetek Inc.
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@lumetek.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Jun 2025 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Net terms & VAT evidence request for pilot expansion

Hi Olivia —

Appreciate the clarity and the PO (thanks). We can be flexible; below is a draft approach that balances Redwood's credit exposure with Lumetek's request for a longer remit window.

Draft proposal (for discussion):
- Billing cadence: monthly invoice for actual usage.
- Payment terms: Net45 for invoices as long as cumulative invoiced amount across the quarter is >= the agreed committed minimum.
- Quarterly true-up: within 15 business days after quarter close we issue a reconciliation statement; overages billed on that reconciliation invoice have Net30 terms.
- Conditional credit limit: Redwood will establish a provisional credit line equal to 1.5x the committed minimum for the pilot period. That limit is subject to review after the first quarter and requires an executed PO + standard vendor checks.
- Prepay/partial prepayment: if vendor checks are incomplete, we can accept a deposit to increase the credit line temporarily.
- VAT: we need Lumetek's EU VAT registration certificate (or your VAT number + supporting doc). We will mark invoices accordingly; our AP requires the certificate before we route invoices to EU entity billing.

Attachments: I have flagged the PO to Finance (Lumetek_PO_12345.pdf). Can you provide the VAT cert and the billing contact for Lumetek EU (name/email) so we can add them to the invoicing config?

Next steps: if that looks reasonable I can draft a short amendment and DocuSign packet (no full contract redline) and loop in Finance for a provisional credit check.

Given timelines I'd like to get an agreement in place by Friday so procurement can begin.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: (referenced) Lumetek_PO_12345.pdf

Date: Tue, 24 Jun 2025 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: credit exposure and provisional limit for Lumetek

Kimberly / Marcus —

Quick internal note on the proposed 1.5x provisional limit:
- Lumetek is mid-market with stable payment history on a previous SaaS vendor (ref via procurement). If we take 1.5x of a modest committed minimum (as Kimberly suggests) the exposure is acceptable for a pilot.
- Conditions I recommend we require up-front:
  - Executed PO + billing contact and VAT cert before enabling Net45 routing.
  - If vendor checks are delayed >10 business days, request a 20% deposit to cover initial months.
  - Auto-escalate to Collections if any invoice >60 days outstanding (no exceptions during pilot).

If Marketing wants to accelerate conversion, we can soften the deposit to 10% but will need to reduce the provisional limit to 1.25x.

I can run the provisional credit check once Kimberly shares the PO and Lumetek's company registration number.

--Priyom
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@lumetek.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 25 Jun 2025 10:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Net terms & VAT evidence request for pilot expansion

Hi Olivia —

Thanks — I looped in Sales Ops and Finance for the provisional checks. Finalized proposal below (short form):

Summary terms: 
- Billing cadence: monthly invoices for actual usage; invoices issued on the 5th of each month (or next business day).
- Payment terms: Net45 applicable provided Lumetek meets the committed minimum spend for the quarter.
- Quarterly reconciliation: we will send a true-up statement within 10 business days after quarter close; any overage invoice from the true-up is Net30.
- Provisional credit limit: 1.5x committed minimum for pilot period, subject to standard checks. If registration/VAT proof is delayed we require either: a 20% deposit or a signed short-form amendment acknowledging provisional terms.
- VAT handling: please send Lumetek's EU VAT registration certificate (PDF) and confirm the EU billing entity and billing email. Once we have the cert we will apply the VAT treatment requested and include the certificate reference on invoices.

DocuSign & next steps: I will prepare a short amendment (no contract-level changes) and a DocuSign packet for signatures. Finance will run a provisional credit check once we have the company reg number and VAT cert.

I attached a sample invoice routing form for your AP to complete (see related link to DocuSign).

If that works, could you confirm:
1) EU billing entity name and VAT number + attached certificate (Lumetek_VAT_certificate.pdf)
2) Preferred AP contact for invoicing (name + email)
3) Bank details to be used for the first invoice (or confirm you will pay deposit)

Thanks — aiming to have the amendment over to you tomorrow.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Lumetek_PO_12345.pdf
Related: https://app.redwood.ai/contracts/LD-2025-117/docuSign
